newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks push off lows, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks push off lows, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: U.S. shares pushed off lows in afternoon trading on Thursday, finding their feet after a bout of profit-taking early in the session.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was trading down 25 points at 8064, well above session lows.
It recouped losses after a bout of profit-taking ate into a recent rally triggered by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat testimony on the economy.
The New York Stock Exchange lifted its curbs on index-arbitrage trading.
The long bond firmed 2/32 to yield 6.43 percent.
